note: 550 sidebar list items and an inline 'In this article' nav that repeats every heading — the duplication case at heading level. The pre floor is here because this page's value is its 30 code samples. HEADING FLOORS SAY 'exactly', CHECKED HEADING BY HEADING 2026-09-05: the source's 9 <h2> are the 7 article sections (Syntax, Vocabulary, Directives, Use Cases, Specifications, Browser compatibility, See also) plus 'In this article' — the inline ToC this fixture exists to punish — plus 'Help improve MDN'. So 7 is source truth for the article, and 'exactly' rather than 'atLeast' is what catches an arm admitting the ToC: a floor of 7 alone cannot fail an arm that brings the duplication in with it. The 7 <h3> and 21 <h4> are all article: the <h4> are the directive names (max-age, private, public, immutable …), one-word headings of real reference content, which is exactly what a 'drop the short blocks' rule deletes. THE TABLE FLOOR FAILS TODAY AND IS MEANT TO: the source has 3 tables — MDN's own header-summary box ('Header type: Request header, Response header / Forbidden request header: No / CORS-safelisted response header: Yes'), the request/response directive matrix, and the specifications table — and the shipped extraction returns 2, having lost the summary box, along with the <figure class='table-container'> that wraps it. minArticleChars 17000: the shipped extraction returns 19,083 gistable characters and is missing only that box; the source body's 28,996 is inflated by 509 sidebar <li>, so 17,000 is the reference page itself with a margin. ARTICLE REGION AND THE FLOOR ON IT, MEASURED 2026-09-05: The reference body less its article-footer holds 16,615 characters against 25,747 for the source body — the difference is the 509-item sidebar, the inline ToC and 'Help improve MDN'. The shipped extraction returns ALL 16,615 of it, and that is worth saying plainly: the header-summary table this fixture fails on is lost as a <table>, not as text, which is why the table floor is the instrument that catches it and a length floor never could. The floor is 15,700.
